Garage description
A paint given exclusively to Gold level members of the game's Parkour Club Support Programme. The name and the colors of the paint indicate what its users can do: soar in the sky like eagles, presenting themselves stylishly at the same time.
  Attention! Players who leave the parkour club will be stripped of their paint.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint appeared on November 20, 2020.
Paint is issued as the Best Parkour Club Award to one parkour club in both the EN and DE locales.
The paint is issued to «The Flying Parkourists», «Flight of Gravity», «Fly to High», and «FeatherLike».
